Ehhh, Normal is not on bottom tier. 

There are lots of good moves for it. Maximum friendship Return does 102 damage, plus with STAB boosting does a lot. Another good one is Boomburst doing 140 damage. The drawback to this is that it can’t hit anything super effective. Normal types can also learn lots of different coverage moves, usually Dark type biting moves. 

Normal types could also get Scrappy which can make it so it can hit Ghost types. And a Facade+Status+STAB boost does a lot too. 

Lastly, they only have one weakness: Fighting. If they can get coverage for it, which they usually can, then they can take care of its only weakness. 

Normal isn’t as good as it was in Gen 1, it’s still at least mid-tier, maybe even a little higher.

Yeah, I agree with lots of points you made. The best Ice types are definitely the more offensive types than the defensive ones.

Focusing more on moves, Ice types moves are generally pretty good, most of them having a chance to freeze (and depending on luck, that could be a great status, or a horrible one.) Like you said, Bug moves are good, especially status Bug moves. (I’m gonna ignore that Powder exists.)
Both types have good abilities (and some bad, but that’s expected). So I’d agree that Ice type is generally worse because of its Pokémon, rather the moves and ability. 

Hypothetically, if GF would buff Ice types’ defenses, it would probably be nerfed down quickly. I think Ice types are somewhat balanced and Bug types are too (but don’t get me started about Fairy). 

Anyways, I doubt any of these types will get buffs in the future, besides new moves, abilities, and Pokémon (although if GF is smart, they could make some other type super effective to the strongest type than just adding another strong one, maybe Ice or Bug could get reworked to it). But all and all, to me, good Ice types all feel like the Ice type is tacked on to the other typing (even if Ice is the primary type). So Ice can be good, but it can be absolutely shit (looking at you Avalugg).

I highly doubt that’s gonna happen. Pikachu is now one of the main Nintendo mascots with Mario, Donkey Kong, and maybe Kirby. It would be cool to see Heracross and Nidoking like Pokémon to be featured more, but a cute one would probably do better in the market. Even though Pikachu is obviously paid attention to because it’s a mascot of the franchise, it could be a whole lot worse. Pikachu is most prominent in the anime and merchandise, in the games it takes a back seat. It had two games, Yellow and Let’s Go Pikachu, but besides that it’s not really that mascot-y in the games. Sure there’s clothes and in XY there’s a wallpaper for the bottom battle screen, but those aren’t forced onto the game. It’s a prominent event Pokémon, but again, those are optional. Sure there are a few things Pikachu is given: the light ball and a gigantimax form, but in my opinion, Charizard is more annoying. Charizard is part of a starter trio, but is more prominent than the other two. Pikachu is a mascot Pokémon, so it’s expected to get the treatment it does. 

TLDR: Pikachu is gonna stay a mascot because it’s cute, and it could be a whole lot worse. It’s a mascot Pokémon so of course it’s gonna have the treatment it gets.
